name: Target Lock
hint: Tap the red center before time runs out.

name: Reactor Parry
hint: Tap as each spark reaches the green ring.

name: Power Sequence
hint: Wait for REPEAT, then tap the flashing colors in order.

name: Brake Check
hint: Tap once when the red needle crosses the green zone.

name: Letter Impostor
objective: Find the Q hiding among the Os!
hint: Look for the tiny tail. A wrong letter ends the round.

name: Knock Knock Beat
objective: Tap each beat at the red line!
hint: Four golden beats approach. Tap as each crosses the line.

name: Pop Quiz Mole
hint: Tap the yellow head; avoid the empty holes.

name: Pocket Change
hint: Drag the blue basket or move left and right.

name: Four Way Shield
hint: Swipe toward the arrow or tap its matching direction.

name: Live Wire
hint: Start at 1 and drag through each numbered node in order.

name: Big Head Energy
objective: Inflate the balloon to its outline!
hint: Tap rapidly. Air leaks between taps.

name: Perfect Pour
objective: Hold to fill. Release in green!
hint: Keep pressing until the red level enters green, then let go.

name: Ink Trick
objective: Match the ink, ignore the word!
hint: Tap the color used to draw the word. Clear three.

name: Six In A Row
objective: Tap one through six in order!
hint: Clear the numbers from smallest to largest.

name: Opposite Day
hint: UP means DOWN. LEFT means RIGHT. Swipe or tap.

name: Satellite Selfie
hint: Tap once when the orbiting red dot reaches the green arc.

name: Lights Out Lunch
hint: Tapping flips that tile and its immediate neighbors.

name: Lunchbox Safe
hint: Read the code left to right. Swipe each arrow or tap its side.

name: Wire You Waiting
objective: Cut only the numbered safe wire!
hint: Read the wire number and tap or swipe across that wire.

name: Pixel Plumber
objective: Repair the right grid to match!
hint: Tap right tiles to toggle them until both patterns match.

name: Two Wall Trouble
objective: Reach GO around the red walls!
hint: Move up around the first wall, down around the second, then to GO.

name: Ceiling Fan Club
objective: Flip gravity to dodge three blocks!
hint: Tap to switch between floor and ceiling before each block.

name: Fruit Or Fix It
objective: Sort six words into the right box!
hint: Fruit goes LEFT. Tools go RIGHT. Swipe or tap a box.

name: Echo Chamber
hint: Watch the first rhythm, then repeat when the dots return.

name: Secret Handshake
objective: Tap only when the door opens!
hint: Wait patiently. Tap the instant the green doorway appears.
